Get the Colspan or Rowspan of a Set of Table Cells

Source: R/get_wikitable.R
dot-cell_span.Rd

Internal helper. Reads a span attribute (`"colspan"` or `"rowspan"`) off a set of `<th>`/`<td>` nodes, defaulting to `1` where the attribute is absent.

Usage

.cell_span(cells, attr_name)

Arguments

cells

An `xml_nodeset` of table cell elements.

attr_name

Character. Either `"colspan"` or `"rowspan"`.

Value

Integer vector, one value per cell.
